title: TTC Routes and Schedules (GTFS)
publisher: Toronto Transit Commission, via City of Toronto Open Data
coverage: City of Toronto and the TTC's routes beyond it
notes: Scheduled stops and route shapes, timetable to 2026-12-21. A route's stops are every stop any of its trips calls at, all branches and both directions.

title: 2021 Census: dissemination areas and Census Profile, City of Toronto
notes: The cartographic boundary file, which follows the shoreline, simplified to about 3 m, with Census Profile counts for each area. 68 of 3743 areas lack some counts, such as low income, which Statistics Canada suppresses for very small areas; they add nothing to those totals. Counts are randomly rounded; 25% sample data are estimates. Low income is counted for people, not households.

commuters.label: Commuters with a usual or no fixed workplace (25% sample)

visibleMinorityBase.label: People counted for visible minority (25% sample)

title: Neighbourhoods (158)
publisher: City of Toronto (Social Development, Finance & Administration)
notes: The 158-neighbourhood model, each with its Toronto Strong Neighbourhoods Strategy 2030 class: Neighbourhood Improvement Area, Emerging Neighbourhood, or neither. Simplified to about 5 m.

title: Neighbourhood Improvement Areas (TSNS 2030)
publisher: City of Toronto (Social Development, Finance & Administration)
notes: The 33 Neighbourhood Improvement Areas of the Toronto Strong Neighbourhoods Strategy 2030, on the 158-neighbourhood model (effective 2022). Not the 31 areas of 2014. Simplified to about 5 m.

title: Motor Vehicle Collisions involving Killed or Seriously Injured Persons
publisher: Toronto Police Service, via City of Toronto Open Data
notes: 7667 police-reported collisions where someone was killed or seriously injured, 2006 to 2026-10-22; the latest year is partial. One point per collision. Police-reported only: collisions police didn't attend are missing.

title: Heritage Register, Don Mills corridor
publisher: City of Toronto (City Planning, Heritage Planning)
coverage: Don Mills corridor only: west -79.37, south 43.70, east -79.32, north 43.78
notes: 55 listed and designated properties inside the corridor box, from the City's public map layer, whose records match the Open Data register. Not for legal purposes.

title: Green Spaces, Don Mills corridor
coverage: Don Mills corridor only: west -79.37, south 43.70, east -79.32, north 43.78
notes: 145 parks, ravine parks, golf courses and cemeteries touching the corridor box, as whole features. Simplified to about 3 m.
